source.title: Nvidia RTX Spark encrypted firmware slows inference speed to 35% on Linux
source.author: novaRom

title.zh: RTX Spark笔记本Linux插电推理降速
title.en: RTX Spark Linux Inference Slows When Plugged In

excerpt.zh: RTX Spark笔记本实测显示，原生Linux插电时GPU频率受限，大模型推理明显落后于Windows与WSL。报道将原因指向电源管理支持缺口，但问题是否影响其他机型、何时修复仍待确认。
excerpt.en: RTX Spark tests show severe Linux inference slowdowns on wall power, linked to missing power management support. WSL retains near-Windows speed.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.en: Why RTX Spark Slows on Wall Power

text.zh: MindStudio对微星Prestige RTX Spark笔记本的实测显示，原生Linux能够运行桌面和CUDA，但插电后GPU频率降至约780MHz，Windows下则约为2.2GHz。GPT-OSS-120B测试中，Windows达到每秒65.4个token，WSL为65.1，原生Linux仅13.9，约为Windows的21%。
text.en: MindStudio’s hands-on test of an MSI Prestige RTX Spark laptop found that native Linux could run a desktop and CUDA, but GPU clocks fell to roughly 780 MHz on wall power, versus about 2.2 GHz under Windows. In its GPT-OSS-120B test, Windows reached 65.4 tokens per second, WSL reached 65.1, and native Linux managed 13.9—about 21% of the Windows result.

text.zh: 反常的是，拔掉电源后，Linux在LM Studio测试中恢复到每秒约61至67个token。报道将问题归因于Nvidia Platform Controllers and Framework：它负责协调CPU与GPU的供电预算，而Linux缺少对应支持。测试中关闭Windows上的该控制器也复现了降速，为这一解释提供了支持；报道还称，其电源配置表经过加密，Linux目前无法解读。
text.en: The unusual detail is that unplugging the laptop restored Linux performance to around 61–67 tokens per second in an LM Studio test. The report attributes the problem to Nvidia Platform Controllers and Framework, which coordinates the CPU and GPU power budget and lacks equivalent Linux support. Disabling that controller in Windows also reproduced the slowdown, supporting this explanation. The report further says its power settings table is encrypted and currently unreadable by Linux.

text.zh: WSL是当前替代方案，适用范围仍待验证
text.en: WSL Offers a Workaround, but Scope Remains Unclear

text.zh: 对希望使用Linux AI工具的开发者，WSL目前更实用：它沿用Windows驱动提供的GPU电源管理，测试性能接近Windows。不过，大模型工作负载需要手动提高WSL内存额度。原生Linux安装也涉及驱动、网络和内存分配调整；测试机默认为GPU预留96GB统一内存，需在Windows中调整后，Linux才能使用更多内存。
text.en: For developers who need Linux AI tools, WSL is the more practical option in these tests because it retains GPU power management through the Windows driver stack and performs close to Windows. Large-model workloads still require manually increasing WSL’s memory allowance. Native Linux setup also involved driver, networking, and memory adjustments: the test machine reserved 96 GB of unified memory for the GPU by default, with that reservation adjustable through Windows.

text.zh: 这些结果来自报道中的特定机器与测试配置，不能直接推及所有RTX Spark笔记本。它揭示的是：CUDA能够运行，并不保证整机电源管理已获得完整支持。原生Linux能否稳定发挥性能，仍取决于Nvidia补齐相关支持；所给材料没有确认修复时间，也未提供跨机型验证。
text.en: These findings concern the machine and configurations described in the report; they do not establish that every RTX Spark laptop behaves identically. The practical lesson is that working CUDA support alone does not guarantee complete platform power management. Consistent native Linux performance still depends on Nvidia addressing that support gap. The supplied material provides neither a confirmed fix timeline nor validation across laptop models.
